visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 20-mark Plato spine -> state each of the 4 arguments -> assess each for validity AND for whether it reaches survival, not just pre-existence -> Simmias objection and reply -> Kant's paralogism -> verdict: suggestive, not probative.

visual_blocks.heading: LAYER 4 - EXAM APPLICATION
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 15-mark karma spine -> define karma (act + adrsta) and its three kinds -> rebirth as the field where fruits mature -> Buddhist continuity twist -> memory + desert objections and replies -> verdict on continuity vs substance.

visual_blocks.heading: LAYER 4 - EXAM APPLICATION
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 10-mark Buddhism spine -> substantialist assumption stated -> anatman + pratityasamutpada -> flame/milk models -> "who reaps the fruit?" reply -> verdict: immortality sufficient, not necessary; Buddhism is decisive.

visual_blocks.heading: LAYER 4 - EXAM APPLICATION
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Whenever a stem names a liberation-term, FIRST fix it on the §5A bench. Half the marks in this clause are lost to term-merging.

visual_blocks.heading: LAYER 4 - EXAM APPLICATION
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 15-mark agent spine -> state the paradox -> Advaita's conventional- agency reply (sublation, not annihilation) -> Visistadvaita's real-jiva answer -> role of knowledge vs grace -> verdict fixing each conception of moksa.

visual_blocks.heading: LAYER 4 - EXAM APPLICATION
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 15-mark Jain spine -> jiva (eternal, conscious, body-sized) -> asrava -> bandha -> samvara -> nirjara -> kevala with ananta-catustaya -> distinguish from Advaita identity and Buddhist cessation -> note the interaction problem.

visual_blocks.heading: LAYER 4 - EXAM APPLICATION
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 10-mark apavarga spine -> Nyaya suffering-chain -> true knowledge reverses it -> cessation of pain AND consciousness -> contrast with Advaita bliss and Samkhya isolation -> verdict: liberation as cessation, not reward.

visual_blocks.heading: LAYER 4 - EXAM APPLICATION
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 15-mark means spine -> production vs removal + saksat vs arad-upakaraka -> Mimamsa (karma) / Sankara (jnana, rejects samuccaya) / Ramanuja (graded samuccaya -> bhakti) / Gita 5.4-5 convergence -> verdict on function vs terminus.

visual_blocks.heading: LAYER 4 - EXAM APPLICATION
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 20-mark trio spine -> define karma, rebirth, reincarnation separately -> interlock them -> contrast resurrection (one life, divine act, Cullmann) -> identity objections BOTH ways -> verdict: neither term is a version of another.
